entities.summary: Ibrahim Wasif was a Light-Heavyweight (75–82.5 kg) in the Egyptian weightlifting team at the Summer Olympics of 1936 in Berlin. He earned a bronze medal for Egypt after lifting a record of 360 kg. This contributed to Egypt's total of 5 medals won during the 1936 games.
